Name: Email the resources to the farmers.
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Describe the main purpose of your mod[/color]
Send resources from your backpack to friends through the in-game mailbox — in online co-op or LAN.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI 4.0+, launch once via StardewModdingAPI.exe.
Extract FarmMail 1.1.0.zip into Stardew Valley/Mods/FarmMail/.
Install the same version on your friend's PC.
Restart the game. Press F6 or click your mailbox to open the menu.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Send items to online or offline friends by mail
Custom note: write a message, friend reads it in the letter
No item loss: failed/timed-out sends refund automatically
Version check: blocks sending to players with missing/old mods
Mint-green themed UI with pixel leaves[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 + SMAPI 4.0+, both players with FarmMail 1.1.0
Recipient must be in the same save file[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the SMAPI team and the Stardew Valley modding community for making this possible.[/color]

Manifest.Name: 农场邮包 FarmMail
Manifest.Description: 给好友寄送资源！按 F6（或点击邮箱）打开寄件界面，把背包里的物品随邮件寄给在线或离线的好友，对方打开邮箱即可领取。
Manifest.Author: Xty
